grammar_bias.stack_basis: same extensional primitive semantics, stack presentation
grammar_bias.excluded: multiplication is not primitive; architecture-family macros are forbidden
grammar_bias.known_bias: small integer arithmetic and positive-part nonlinearity strongly privilege piecewise-linear arithmetic programs

search_bias.S2: breadth-first stack-state search, max stack depth 3
search_bias.known_bias: both favor short exact programs; neither is a neutral distribution over all programs

ecology_bias.known_bias: tiny exact binary tasks are not representative of large-scale learning

resource_bias.frozen_scalar: build + H*per_use used only for one held-out regime prediction
resource_bias.known_bias: registered costs are synthetic and not hardware calibration

evaluation_bias.search_reward: external exact task correctness + registered primitive/resource burden only

stopping_bias: exact satisfaction or frozen size/length budget
claim_boundary: Architecture-uncommitted only relative to this disclosed bias ledger; not assumption-free/prior-free.
